name: bian
description: BIAN Service Domain Architecture — the A2 layer, its types, link types and inference rules, and the BIAN 14 catalogue (banking)

scope.note: horizontal: a layer of its own between A1 and A3, the reserved A2 (BX-04, BX-43)

uses: sdem.api 0.1 (ST-20, ST-21) — its sdem bian commands run through SDEM's command line (sdem.api.run)
reads: nothing itself — SDEM reads its data folder
licence: Apache-2.0; the BIAN catalogue extract carries its own licence (data/catalogue/LICENSE)
contract: SDEM extension contract EXT-01…EXT-15, metamodel extensions MX-01…MX-44, BIAN package BP-01…BP-11, stable identity ST-20…ST-22 (taumoeps/sdem)

builds_on.note: MX-41: the core types BIAN's link types and inference rules reach
